item.title: Fort Bend County Primary Election Results
item.description: Fort Bend County voters headed to the polls Tuesday for the Republican and Democratic primaries, with Republican Daniel Wong winning the County Judge race outright while Democrat Dexter McCoy is headed to a runoff against Rachelle Carter.

item.title: Methodist West Surgeon says colorectal cancer rising among younger adults; screening can save lives
item.description: Colorectal cancer, long considered a disease of older adults, is now the leading cause of cancer-related death among Americans under 50 — and it is the only major cancer with a rising death rate in that age group.

item.title: Milton Wright, Fort Bend County Sheriff for 15 Years, Has Died
item.description: Milton Wright, a former Fort Bend County sheriff who was present in Dallas on the day President John F. Kennedy was assassinated, has died.

item.title: Calhoun County GOP missed deadline to report primary election results after choosing to hand-count ballots
item.description: By Natalia Contreras, Votebeat and The Texas Tribune

item.title: UH Bauer College of Business Brings Executive Education to Katy
item.description: West Houston business leaders will soon have access to University of Houston executive education programs without traveling into the city, as C. T. Bauer College of Business expands its professional development offerings to Katy.

item.title: Fort Bend County Judge KP George goes to trial Tuesday on money laundering charges
item.description: Fort Bend County Judge KP George is set to stand trial Tuesday on two felony counts of money laundering, with jury selection expected to begin in the 458th District Court before Judge Maggie Jaramillo at the Fort Bend County Justice Center.

item.title: Westbound Westheimer Parkway at Mason Road closed; repairs could take days
item.description: The westbound lanes of Westheimer Parkway, at South Mason Road, were closed Tuesday as crews worked to repair a water or sewer main break that has undermined the roadway,

item.title: Katy ISD facing $29 million budget shortfall after fewer students show up than expected
item.description: Katy Independent School District is facing a $29 million budget deficit after the state cut the district's funding because fewer students enrolled than the district had planned for.

item.title: Rufus Summers, former interim Katy fire chief, dies
item.description: Rufus Summers, who served as Katy's interim fire chief from 2013-16, has died. He was 86.

item.title: EDITORIAL: 'Purer?' McFarlane's victory remarks echo the language of history's most dangerous despots
item.description: Tamara McFarlane has won the Republican primary for Fort Bend County Clerk. In her victory statement, she declared the Fort Bend County Republican Party Marxist and vowed to make it "purer." All residents should pay close attention to those words.
